description: This file defines the TimesheetEntriesParamRule class, which implements validation logic for timesheet entry parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It checks the structure, required fields, date formats, and relationships between projects and activities within timesheet entries.

classes.name: TimesheetEntriesParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies the correctness and consistency of timesheet entry parameters, ensuring proper structure, valid IDs, dates, durations, and relationships for timesheet submissions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation rule with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: getApiDateRule
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ApiDate validation rule used for date validation.

methods.name: getTimeRule
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a Time validation rule for duration validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of an array of timesheet entry data, including structure, IDs, date formats, date ranges, durations, and consistency with the existing timesheet.
